title: AppFlowy — Discovery
script: An open-source workspace can still have a paid cloud plan. AppFlowy offers a workspace for pages and structured work. The client and hosted service are different parts of the decision. Before comparing it with Notion, I want to know what works locally and what my plan includes. The free hosted tier has limits. Team size, storage, and AI usage need a current check. The useful question is whether my pages and tables still work when the network disappears. Next I am rebuilding one workspace in AppFlowy and Notion, then testing offline use and export.
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Docs, tables, Kanban, calendar, forms and local/cloud options.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: An open-source workspace can still have a paid cloud plan.
An open client does not mean unlimited free cloud.
Check the plan before moving your workspace.
strongestHook: An open-source workspace can still have a paid cloud plan.
directorBrief: Direct this as a useful discovery with one important limit: Docs, tables, Kanban, calendar, forms and local/cloud options. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Capture current AppFlowy client version, license, hosted plan and official limits. Create a synthetic five-row workspace. Record actual available table/board/page operations. Identify local and hosted modes separately. Avoid claiming offline use before disconnect test and avoid claiming free cloud has unlimited team/AI/storage access.
evidenceRequirements: Verify current client license, hosted pricing and free limits.

music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: App, repo, official pricing, Notion reference.
